preserved_assertions: Fixed-display assertions retained and consolidated in the core fixture; unsupported generic orientations/layouts explicitly retired per tests/fixed-layout-migration.md, source archived before deletion. Native symbol/lock migration preserves every current fixed-display assertion; old private 5x7 ASCII and column APIs are retired per the same migration map.

execution.quick: All host behavioral scenarios once; sanitizers on C fixtures; validator/process units once.
execution.full: Same host scenarios under optimized, sanitizer and measured coverage builds; kernel and supported stock/DYA interfaces use the separate integration entry.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten. Optional online wrapper ZMK_TEST_OUTPUT mounts retained output; offline output stays mandatory and performs no update.
execution.coverage: Every selected gated function range requires executable gcov lines; empty/unrelated/missing ranges fail closed. Synthetic recording-tool regressions validate admission, not firmware behavior.
execution.integration: Unchanged stock and DYA owner matrices retain firmware/peripheral/native runtime/blank/external-port configurations and all assertions; each native executable runs three times without rebuilding.

gaps: Host extracted functions and controlled registry/kernel/tool stand-ins are not real scheduling or storage evidence.
Physical panel/I2C/shared-bus deadlines, USB/BLE/split delivery, reset persistence and power/current require matching production-board evidence.
Hosted moving-core CI and artifact upload require an observed hosted run, separate from locally audited offline pins.

Public LED dependencies use manifest HTTPS with no CI secret. A currently private LED dependency still needs separately provisioned read access; optional key support grants none. Admission tests do not prove online fetch/build success.
fixed_display: Fixed 72x40 physical storage, 40x72 drawing, two 360-byte buffers; no configurable orientation or projection

render_efficiency.cache: Exact40-byte status or32-bit LED tuple plus kind;44-byte cache on supported ARM/native ABI; reset at canvas init; work-handler ownership
render_efficiency.contracts: Status acquisition preserved while dark; repeated identical notifications skip actual rendering; view switch/change/reset redraw; unknown pages/refresh/retries still flush.
render_efficiency.negative_control: tests/check_render_cache.py requires normal pass and exact draw/write assertion failure with test-only bypass
render_efficiency.benchmark: Eleven explicit mixed/repeated/single-field workloads, same actual headers/input/compiler, >=3 repeats per binary. Host CPU only; Flash/RAM must come from real linked firmware.
render_efficiency.partial: Six fixed normal groups and bounded LED ranges reuse the same44-byte cache; peer visibility invalidates B/L label; unchanged intermediate LED value restored. Full view changes/reset and complete status updates retain full rendering.
render_efficiency.partial_control: tests/test_partial_render.c runs under quick/full; check_partial_render.py compiles the same fixture against actual prior/current headers and requires exact original sentinel assertion failures plus current complete-frame equality.
